planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno and wiring is preserved per requirement: HC-SR04 Trig=D8 Echo=D9, TM1637 CLK=D4 DIO=D5, LED=D13, buzzer/tone=D6.

Ultrasonic acquisition and validity are declared as a paired distance+valid interface with identical pins, timeout, and sample_period_ms. Invalid/out-of-range sets validity false and retains last distance per invalid_policy=hold_last_valid; decision logic belongs in the SysML model.
TM1637 number is driven over the CLK/DIO bus; digit selection, rounding to integer cm, and any out-of-range blanking behavior (if the model chooses to) are handled in SysML.
LED active_high=true means the model's boolean true drives the LED ON; no inversion is applied in the device request.

Buzzer uses tone_output on D6. The SysML model controls when tone is active (including slow/fast beep cadence) using elapsed_ms; this device request only defines the physical tone channel and silence behavior.

Control period is set to 10ms for timely buzzer cadence decisions and responsive threshold switching; ultrasonic sample_period_ms is scheduled as 60ms (>=ceil((timeout_us+12)/1000)) and >=60ms, aligned to a control-period multiple.
No Serial reporting/input requirements were provided, so serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Parking assist distance (HC-SR04), coherent per acquisition frame

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display distance (cm), model selects digits/blanking

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Parking assist LED ON when distance < 30cm

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer tone generated by model: slow beep when <15cm, fast beep when <8cm

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个超声波停车辅助系统，使用 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。数码管显示距离；当距离小于 30cm 时 LED 点亮，小于 15cm 时蜂鸣器慢鸣，小于 8cm 时蜂鸣器急促鸣叫。
